EX-99.1 2 vtvt-20260930xexx991pressr.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 vTv Therapeutics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update Phase 3 CATT1 trial evaluating cadisegliatin for the treatment of type 1 diabetes (T1D) completed enrollment with 166 participants randomized; topline results expected mid 2027 Randomized the first participant in its Phase 2a Hybrid CATT1 pilot study evaluating cadisegliatin in individuals with T1D who use hybrid closed-loop (HCL) insulin delivery systems Company hosted a Key Opinion Leader (KOL) event in October, highlighting cadisegliatin and its potential to address hypoglycemia in people with T1D FDA granted Orphan Drug Designation to HPPD, the Company’s oral, first-in-class Nrf2/Bach1 modulator being investigated as a potential treatment for sickle cell disease Strong balance sheet expected to fund operations well through Phase 3 CATT1 topline data readout HIGH POINT, N.C., November 5, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) – vTv Therapeutics Inc.

In October 2026, the Company announced completion of enrollment in its Phase 3 CATT1 trial and continues to expect topline results in mid 2027, and randomized the first participant in Hybrid CATT1, its Phase 2a study of cadisegliatin in individuals with T1D who use hybrid closed-loop insulin delivery systems.
Based on its cash position as of September 30, 2026, vTv expects to have sufficient cash to fund operations well through the anticipated CATT1 topline data readout.

“Completing enrollment in the Phase 3 CATT1 trial is a significant milestone for vTv, and we look forward to reporting topline results in mid 2027,” said Paul Sekhri, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer of vTv Therapeutics.
Topline results are expected in mid 2027.
